guideDescription: Optional walkthrough — each skipped step is another week of double entry. Set the school up once.
setupPaused: Setup guide paused - {completed} of {total} steps done.

account.title: Make yourself findable
account.subtitle: Without a clear name and face, messages and approvals stall while people guess who you are. Two minutes now saves that friction every day.
account.welcomeBody: You're in as a {role}. Next we lock in your name and an optional photo so your team stops chasing the wrong person in chat and reports.
account.displayNameHint: This is what shows on messages, reports, and approvals — not a nickname people have to decode.
account.nameRequired: Please enter your name to continue.
account.saveFailed: Could not save your name. Try again.
account.cameraHint: Center your face in the frame, then capture. You can retake before saving.
account.cameraUnsupported: This device or browser does not support camera capture. Upload a photo instead.
account.cameraPermissionDenied: Camera access was denied. Allow camera permission, or upload a photo instead.
account.cameraCaptureFailed: Could not capture the photo. Try again.
account.photoPrompt: Optional — a face beats another anonymous initial in the staff list. JPG, PNG, GIF, or WebP up to 5MB.
account.photoReady: Photo uploaded. You can upload or take a new one.
account.photoUploadFailed: Could not upload your photo. Try again.
account.photoRequired: Add a profile photo to finish setup.
account.homescreenHeadline: Add ShuleOS to your home screen
account.completeFailed: Could not finish setup. Try again.

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.description: A short pass so your account stops looking like a blank seat.

profile.title: Your name
profile.description: Confirm the name people should trust when they message or approve you.

photo.title: Profile photo
photo.description: Add a photo so staff and families recognize you at a glance. Upload a file or take one with your camera — or skip and add it later in Settings.

homescreen.title: Home screen
homescreen.description: If ShuleOS stays a Safari tab, the next closed tab takes the school with it. Pin it once — about ten seconds.

structure.title: Welcome to {school}
structure.subtitle: Pick every level you run. Leave one out and those classes get invented later — never quite matching the rest.
structure.skipSuccess: Structure setup skipped. You can create classes anytime.
structure.skipFailed: Could not skip setup. Try again.
structure.levelRequired: Select at least one school level to continue.
structure.customGradesOnly: Add the grade names your school actually uses.
structure.noStudentsNote: Classes only — no demo students will be created.
structure.createSuccess: Created {count} classes. Your structure is ready.
structure.createFailed: Could not create classes. Try again.

level.title: School levels
level.description: Tick every level on this campus so the grade list isn't rebuilt mid-term.

grades.title: Grades
grades.description: Select every grade you run. Uncheck what you don't need — add custom names if the list is incomplete.

confirm.title: Confirm
confirm.description: Review the skeleton. Students stay empty until you enroll real ones.

website.title: Set up your public website
website.description: Families search before they visit. Without a site, they enroll elsewhere — add your story, contact details, and branding.

team.title: Invite your team
team.description: Teachers keep doing double entry until they're in — add teachers, bursars, and admins with role-specific dashboards.

subjects.title: Create subjects
subjects.description: Without subjects, gradebooks and report cards have nothing to attach to — define the courses before classes pile up.

classes.title: Create classes
classes.description: Leave classes unset and enrollments get invented later, never quite matching — pick every level and grade you run.

students.title: Enroll your first student
students.description: Until the first student is on the roll, attendance, grades, and fees have nowhere to land.

timetable.title: Build your timetable
timetable.description: Without a timetable, teachers guess rooms and parents can't see the day — assign subjects and teachers to periods.

publish.title: Publish your website
publish.description: An unpublished site still loses families who never find you — enable it when the page is ready so they can apply.
